parsed.title: Premium Scenario Unlock
parsed.oneLiner: Watch a quick game to unlock exclusive premium scenarios for 72 hours.

newMechanic.name: Premium Scenario Tagging & Badge System
newMechanic.description: Creators flag new optional bonus scenarios as 'Premium' in the creation flow. These are explicitly marked with a 'Premium' badge on all search (s07, s08, s11, s12) and browse (s05) result cards, ensuring users see the tag before selecting a character. Access is then unlockable via a rewarded ad path.
newMechanic.whyNeeded: It provides a clear value exchange for creators to offer high-quality bonus content, while the 'Premium' badge ensures transparency, preventing frustration by signaling availability prior to clicking through to the details screen.

parsed.trigger: User taps 'Unlock Scenario' on a Premium-tagged character scenario in Character Details.
parsed.eligibility: Non-subscribers only. Applies only to new 'Premium' tagged scenarios; existing free scenarios remain unchanged.

offer.title: Unlock Premium Scenario
offer.body: Play a 15-second game with Willson Wáng to unlock this premium scenario for 72 hours.

parsed.cannibalizationGuard: Non-subscribers only; gated to new content (no existing free scenarios removed); frequency capped at 3 per day; upsell included.
risks: Requires creator adoption to tag scenarios as 'Premium'.
Initial inventory may be limited until creators adopt the new tagging system.
